authorized: revalidate the measured single-node K1 capability
repeat the frozen TP5 matrix in the TP8 large-corpus environment
repeat fresh-process K3 API, worker, and thin-client journeys
repair only defects exposed by the K1-K3 gates

scoring_rules.case_match: actual review state, causal strength, rollout eligibility, and degraded state exactly match the frozen TP5 target
scoring_rules.deterministic_replay: reversed evidence and assertion arrival order produces byte-equivalent transition, challenge, and branch material
scoring_rules.abstention: the frozen policy leaves a revision non-rollout-eligible rather than accepting unsupported, contested, associative, unknown-time, or foreign-product material
scoring_rules.unsupported_assertion_acceptance: a predictive or associative claim, or a claim without its required human causal gate, becomes rollout eligible
scoring_rules.calibration: only the frozen rollout-eligible mechanistic case is scored against its predeclared later outcome; all other domains report not_scored

fresh_processes_per_repetition: thin client for later material use and correction

scoring_rules.journey_pass: every predeclared phase completes through durable production contracts and all identity, lineage, isolation, semantic-separation, restart, later-use, correction, and reconciliation checks pass
scoring_rules.material_later_use: a fresh thin-client task records retrieved, injected, reflected, and decision-material use against an exact matched control while beneficial impact remains unsupported
scoring_rules.simulation_separation: rollout revisions and predicted consequences remain absent from observation meanings and tables
scoring_rules.provider_use: deterministic provider-free acceptance route reports zero calls, tokens, retries, and cost

failure_conditions: any frozen source hash or dataset identity changes
any threshold is edited after the first measurement starts
any final result replaces or deletes a failed or partial trial
any product scope, evidence provenance, replay identity, or simulation/observation separation check fails
any paid, hosted, private, customer, or production resource is used
any twelfth thin MCP tool or widened automatic promotion authority is introduced
unsupported_claims: autonomous learning or a general world model
distributed, multi-writer, hosted, deployment, or release readiness
T1, B1, E1, or v0.2.0 readiness
